final: WITH joined AS (SELECT m.member_id, mj.college FROM member m JOIN major mj ON mj.major_id = m.link_to_major), grp AS (SELECT college, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY college), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM grp WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), ratio AS (SELECT g.college, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM grp g CROSS JOIN tot t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), avgc AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM grp WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.college, r.cnt, r.share, r.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM ratio r CROSS JOIN avgc a WHERE r.cnt > a.avg_cnt
